parties.respondent: The State of Uttar Pradesh & Anr.

summary: Section 319 Cr.P.C. summoning order; prior hearing before addition as accused; reliance on Jogendra Yadav (2015) 9 SCC 244; High Court affirmed summoning; appellant not heard before being added; submission that natural justice demands prior hearing; State argues context-specific nature of Jogendra Yadav; concern over trial disruption and delay; Bench considers whether prior hearing is mandatory under Section 319; issue of discharge rights for summoned accused.
